question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Plausible
solution:
The correct answer is **'Credible.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us see the meaning of Plausible:

 
 
• Plausible: that you can believe; reasonable. (विश्‍वसनीय; तर्कसंगत)
 
 
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• **Irresistible: **so strong that it cannot be stopped or prevented. (इतना शक्तिशाली कि उसका प्रतिरोध या अवरोध न हो; अप्रतिरोध्य)
 
• **Irrational: **not based on reason or clear thought. (जो तर्क या स्‍पष्‍ट चिंतन पर आधारित न हो; तर्कहीन, विवेकहीन, अतार्किक)
 
• **Untenable: **(especially of a position or view) not able to be maintained or defended against attack or objection. ((विशेष रूप से किसी स्थिति या दृश्य के) हमले या आपत्ति के खिलाफ बनाए रखने या बचाव करने में सक्षम नहीं)
 
• **Credible: **that you can believe. (विश्‍वसनीय; विश्‍वास करने योग्‍य)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the word "Credible" is the appropriate synonym of the word "Pausible​."
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.
